lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in three primary horizontal rows along the visible mid-flank, posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal ridges, forming a grid-like pattern where high-luminance blobs are frequently positioned at the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-reflecting dorsal surfaces and shadowed ventral edges.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the lower lateral flank, positioned ventrally to the mid-flank ridges and posterior to the pectoral fin.
